name: NewJob: Like Speed Dating but for Hiring
source:
You have stage fright but for job interviews. It's kind of a problem since you need a part-time job--you wanna eat at fancy places with your friends, after all.
NewJob might just be the thing for you! It's speed dating--but instead of matching couples together, it matches bosses with prospective employees. Be speed-interviewed by not one, but five bosses in a row! Answer correctly and you might just land yourself some work!
[From [url=https://frances.itch.io/newjob-like-speed-dating-but-for-hiring] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
但对于工作面试，你会怯场。这是一个问题，因为你需要一份兼职工作——毕竟你想和朋友一起去高档的地方吃饭。
NewJob可能正适合你！这是快速约会——但它不是将情侣配对在一起，而是将老板与未来的员工配对。连续接受五个老板的快速采访！回答正确，你可能会找到一些工作！
[来自[url=https://frances.itch.io/newjob-like-speed-dating-but-for-hiring] itch.io[/url]]
